items.label: Define mandatory terminal return for every WORK room.
items.evidenceTarget: The routing model and orchestration rules state that every WORK room must return PASS, FAIL, BLOCKER, RISK, or UNKNOWN to PLAN.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-work-type-routing-model.md and docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md require a terminal return for every WORK room outcome.

items.label: Define PLAN room liveness monitoring.
items.evidenceTarget: The Room Run Registry records Return Channel, Liveness Signal, livenessDeadline, lastHeartbeatAt, Death Signal, retrievable locator, and next PLAN action.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md adds Return Channel, Liveness Signal, livenessDeadline, lastHeartbeatAt, and deathSignal to Room Run Registry tracking.

items.label: Define silent room handling.
items.evidenceTarget: The rules state that a silent room, disappeared room, or missing terminal return must not be accepted and must become a PLAN-visible state.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-work-type-routing-model.md and docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md require PLAN to record returned-silent, needs-attention, RISK, UNKNOWN, or blocked before deciding whether to pull, ask for a room reference, reopen the lane, shrink the dispatch set, or block the round.

items.label: Route return and liveness requirements to PLAN and Kickoff Packets.
items.evidenceTarget: First delivery lane Kickoff Packets and global/agent guidance carry Return Channel, Liveness Signal, Death Signal, mandatory return, and no-acceptance-on-silence rules.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan.md adds Return Channel, Liveness Signal, and Death Signal to every Kickoff Packet; AGENTS.md and docs/domains/flowdoc-global-codex-guidance.md route future rooms to the mandatory return and liveness rule.
